request: make a tiny poll: cats or dogs, two buttons, show both counts, and keep the votes on the server so they survive a reload
design_rationale: A two-button poll is voted on and glanced at, so one centred card with the question, two equal buttons and two large tabular counts; neutral base with the template's amber accent.

verify.steps: Open the poll, see Cats: 0 and Dogs: 0, click Vote cats twice and Vote dogs once, see Cats: 2 and Dogs: 1, reload and still see Cats: 2 and Dogs: 1.

why.services/poll.jac: Ballot node holding the cat and dog counts; read_votes returns it and vote(side) adds one for that side, creating the node under root on first use.
why.components/PollScreen.jac: The whole screen: the Cats or dogs? heading, the Vote cats and Vote dogs buttons, and the Cats: N and Dogs: N lines with a loading state.
why.main.jac: Registers the poll endpoints, loads global.css and renders the poll screen.

write_reasoning.services/poll.jac: Backend first: one Ballot node under root found by a private _ballot helper, and only def:pub functions are exposed. vote takes the side as a str and returns the node so the client never re-reads through the cached read_votes.
write_reasoning.components/PollScreen.jac: read_votes is awaited once in async can with entry and cast is async because it awaits vote; both copy the fields of the returned node into state through a local. The numbers shown are always what the last server call returned.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac imports read_votes, vote and Ballot from services.poll with no leading dot so the server module is loaded, then renders the screen; one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with one saved tally of two numbers, so a single component and a tiny server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: a heading, two vote buttons and the Cats and Dogs counts. Both numbers live on one Ballot node under root behind two def:pub functions; the client loads them on mount and takes the new numbers from vote. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan written to .jaccoder/build_plan.json: a single-screen poll, 4 files leaf-first, both counts on one server node via read_votes and vote, nova/neutral/amber/inter.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- A def:pub read is cached on the client on jac 0.34.28, so read_votes is called only on mount and the screen shows the node vote returns.

## Learnings
- One Ballot node under root, found with [root-->][?:Ballot] and created on first use, keeps both counts across reloads.
- The mount effect and the vote handler copy the returned fields through a local before setting state.

## Last Action
Built Cats or dogs?: two vote buttons and the Cats: N and Dogs: N lines loaded from the server on open. Two cat votes and one dog vote show Cats: 2 and Dogs: 1, still there after a reload.
final:
Cats or dogs? is running: it shows the saved counts when you open it, and each click on Vote cats or Vote dogs adds one vote on the server. I voted cats twice and dogs once, saw Cats: 2 and Dogs: 1, reloaded and they were unchanged.

**Next steps**
- Add a Reset button
- Add a third option
- Show each side as a percentage
